audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Lemma V.1 substitutes a limiting length for a nonzero finite-stage logarithmic error; The weighted Wente estimate fails for boundary concentration because the weight tends to zero at r=1; Nearest-point projection acceleration and a sphere projection-derivative sign are incorrect
limitations: Limits: Only the exact arXiv v2 PDF with the stated hash was scientifically reviewed; no accepted-manuscript or journal-version equivalence is asserted.
Limits: The local radial counterexample is not a full-disk finite-energy harmonic map and is not claimed to refute the global fixed-surface or degenerating-closed-surface index theorem.

Limits: The replacement Wente inequality and extension/projection interfaces are proved; no complete independent proof of all cited gauge, Lorentz, bubble compactness, or general-target regularity results is claimed.
Limits: The general repaired collar estimate remains unproved in this report.
Limits: Code and supplements were not found in bounded searches; this is not proof of nonexistence and absence of code is not a defect.
Limits: The original source manifest's acquisition token, encoding, identity and frozen year were preserved; the current review uses its distinct assigned batch token.

Limits: The original executor source-text review and exact scientific calculation outputs are reused unchanged. The current native helper inspected 43 retained source evidence images and all 9 current report pages, and performed the current final only-cached compilation.

Counterevidence: The actual Lemma V.1 is expressly local on annuli and imposes no global closed-surface extension, full-disk finite energy or extra Hopf constraint. The report explicitly does not apply this map to the stronger Theorem I.2 hypotheses. Even an eventual-in-k reading fails. A finite-stage residual or Lambda+epsilon bound would not be contradicted.
Counterevidence: If W1,2(C) was intended homogeneously, the function-space issue is a clarification; the report expressly states this. The explicit cutoff/boundary-matching problem remains.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
